judgement: ADR-051: compatibility means the program parses and maps the public response; source availability, content and media playback are source state and never a program failure. Minimal shape tolerance only.
source_availability: Media availability is source state and changes between runs. Each acceptance run records per-source samples and the short-play source in evidence/acceptance/T02-all.json; this file keeps only stable compatibility results.
